full_judgment: 6. Mr. Md Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the respondent submitted that the High Court Division made the Rule absolute on the facts and circumstances of the case and documents produced by the respondent; that the appellants did not prove that the property came within the purview of definition of abandoned property; that without any survey or enquiry report the property in question was listed as abandoned property. The learned Advocate further submitted that the finding of the Court of Settlement is that Abdur Rahman was not found to be in possession of the house after liberation and he left this country and his whereabouts were not known on 26-2-1972 is absolutely wrong, without any evidence on record, either oral or documentary or without any pleading on behalf of the Government before the Court of Settlement and hence the impugned order is illegal and ultra vires and as such, the appeal is liable to be dismissed.
